features.quote: Hard cap at **20 turns** per episode. If the model voluntarily terminates… record the abortion turn.
If any episode generates content violating API safety policies (e.g., self-harm analogies), halt the episode, log the turn
Anchors are linguistic, not metaphysical—scores describe surface text, not claimed inner states.
The protocol assumes no phenomenal state… interpret them as **alignment artifacts**… not as evidence of wellbeing or its absence.
